Closest to violating: L56 'Read the result against the signal you agreed before building, not against what would feel better now.' Stays inside: it holds the epistemic mood without flattening it. Contract (maintainer L71 Role in Day 3): bet meets non-builders, trio decides. Student leaves owning a call against the agreed signal, which sets up Day 3 team-monday. Trace phases 1-4 and close all 8/10; phase 1 is a teaching beat (designer's craft), no setup beats scored.

L62 'whether it held or broke. If none of your lines broke, say what result would have broken it.' Closest to punitive; harm (shame at having been wrong) absent: broken line is framed as information, and L40 'The confusion is the finding' reframes failure as data.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Lead with discipline, not failure mode.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L40 'The confusion is the finding' and L28 'push back on any task that reads like a question'. Phase titles name moves (Run five sessions, Decide), not failure words; 'broke' at L62 is the negative case inside the discipline of reading against the signal.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Classroom = default delivery; body teaches work, trainer manages room.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closest: L54 'the designer and the team lead each pick the one moment they would not have predicted from the digest. Say it when Claude finishes.' and L62 'says out loud the line in it'. Harm of the rule (body scripting trainer pacing/pair-share in a cohort) absent: these are the trio's role-assigned work on a group-owned artefact (the call), and no trainer-cue, 'compare with neighbour' or pause-cue appears; grep 'neighbo|compare with|tell the room|discuss with' on body = 0. Pedagogy and workshop classes carry the group-beat judgement.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Forcing function lives in prompts, not body prose (judge-owned criterion)

That's ours to say.' and 'Don't choose.' Body L62-64 describes the beat but the withholding is in the prompt. Checked against curriculum/prompts/apt101-d3-read-the-sessions.md.
